text:
Carla: Heads-up — just hit a pretty annoying repro on iOS: when the keyboard opens while editing a filter inline, the bottom action bar overlaps the table rows and primary actions become unreachable. Screenshot + short screen capture: https://imgur.com/abcd1234.mp4
Ben: can repro on iPhone 12 / Safari. steps: Console > Routes table > click row > tap filter input. Keyboard pushes viewport and action bar stays sticky over keyboard.
Alice: ugh — feels like sticky + safe-area + keyboard dance. Two options: 1) convert action bar into a floating sheet above the keyboard when focus is in an input, 2) collapse to a single kebab overflow so nothing is hidden. Accessibility-wise we need aria labels and predictable focus.
Dmitri: quick thought: sticky + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) helps with notch but not with soft keyboard. On iOS WKWebView the viewport height doesn't change reliably. Could detect keyboard by window.innerHeight drop (if > 150px) and add .keyboard-mode class to body. CSS fallback: .actionbar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; } but need to avoid double-scroll.
Emily: adding failing repros to the ticket — our e2e mobile run flaked 7/10 times on Safari mobile. Also saw similar behavior on Android Chrome WebView when keyboard is fullscreen. Repro steps & logs: https://tests.redwood/issue/3287
Carla: product impact: prevents quick inline edits and causes users to miss the primary CTA. Marking P2. Can we get a user-visible patch next sprint? Ben + Dmitri to pair on fix.
Ben: I can prototype a viewport-height breakpoint: @media (max-height: 420px) { .actionbar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } } Use max-height instead of keyboard detection API since that’s more consistent across browsers. Also will add: .actionbar[data-mode="sheet"] { border-top-left-radius: 12px; border-top-right-radius: 12px; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); }
Alice: small copy tweak: when the bar is in edit/keyboard mode, switch "Run" -> "Apply" and add aria-label="Apply filter". Also add a visible grab handle for the sheet and +8px top padding so it doesn't collide with the sticky table header.
Dmitri: creating draft PR #1423. Implementation plan: 1) keyboard-mode detection via innerHeight delta, 2) toggle .keyboard-mode on body, 3) actionbar switches to fixed bottom sheet with focusable overflow menu fallback for legacy iOS. I'll include visual tests and a feature flag.
design-bot: New figma spec uploaded: https://figma.com/file/XYZ/actionbar-mobile-sheet — includes handle, spacing, and alt overflow menu. :white_check_mark:
Emily: tested Ben's prototype on iPhone SE in staging — big improvement but the sheet handle currently overlaps the sticky table header by ~6px on small heights. Suggest increase sheet top padding and ensure the table header gets a bottom margin when keyboard-mode is active.
Ben: noted. I'll bump the top padding and add a small animated translate so the header slides out slightly when the sheet animates in to avoid overlap. Also will add aria-hidden toggles for non-active interactive items.
Carla: thanks! Created Jira RD-3412 with scope: hotfix to staging (apply CSS & keyboard detection) + follow-up full solution for next sprint (PR + e2e). Assigning to @Ben and @Dmitri. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: merging hotfix to staging today, working on tests tomorrow.
Carla: closing thread — will update RD-3412 with test matrix.
